payload.title: CUT-SET-PROV: Operator Settings consumes Providers root only
currentProgress: HTTP-SET (#1516), MCP-SET (#1514), and CLI-SET (#1521 / fdefd3dc7) are Factory-terminal; Settings is adapter-complete for transport packets.
IMP-SET-01/02, CTR-SET, and LWR-SET are Factory-terminal.
Live Operator Settings already imports pkg/services/providers root from resolution/wire paths; residual Providers construction still reaches providers/wire in Settings-owned wire/tests.
IMP-PROV-04 Cursor/OpenCode adapters are live under Providers ownership; this packet leases only Settings→Providers consumer edges and must not reopen provider adapter groups.
Operator Settings still has transitional top-level debt (servicewire/, identityinventory/, testlink/, excess root .go); fold/DEL is out of scope for this CUT.
payload.requestedOutcome: Lease only Operator Settings call sites that still reach Providers through non-root paths (including providers/wire construction helpers used as peer imports from Settings production code) or loose Providers surfaces. Retarget those imports/call sites so Settings production code queries Providers only through the Providers service root contract for semantic validation and catalog facts, matching the PSS cross-service rule that Settings may query Providers but does not own catalog facts. Do not fold or delete operator_settings/servicewire, identityinventory, or other Settings transitional dirs. Do not edit root pkg/wire except if an unavoidable Settings→Providers import edge must move with the consumer cut. Do not touch IMP-PROV-04/05 adapter paths, LWR-PROV, PSS-I0* shared integrators, or reopen Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Prove with focused Settings/Providers boundary tests that Settings constructs Providers requests only through the Providers root. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
changedPathLease: exclude pkg/services/providers/** except through Providers root contract imports
exclude pkg/wire except unavoidable Settings→Providers edge retarget
acceptanceCriteria: Operator Settings production code imports Providers only through the Providers service root contract
No new Settings production imports of Providers implementation packages or providers/wire as a peer dependency
Focused tests prove Providers query/request construction through the root boundary (behavioral import-boundary or fake-root proof)
Existing Settings document load/update/atomic persist and effective resolution behavior is preserved
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; blocking PR comments addressed; conflicts reconciled; PR merged before Factory completion

Inventing Settings HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters or reopening accepted CLI UX
Editing Providers adapter groups (IMP-PROV-04+) while claiming a Settings consumer CUT
Folding operator_settings transitional dirs in this CUT packet
Marking CUT complete while production Settings still imports providers/wire or Providers internals
